prompt:
Use case: isolated industrial-equipment component reconstruction
Asset type: one standalone reusable transparent PNG component for an editable industrial process diagram.
Input images: Image 1 is the approved full-slide concept; use it for this heat exchanger's position, silhouette, view, colors and lighting. Image 2 is the earlier transparent group; use it only for detailed construction of the heat exchanger.
Primary request: Reconstruct exactly one independent plate heat exchanger assembly from the references.
Subject: the lower-right heat exchanger only: one upright rectangular dark-blue steel frame holding a dense stack of closely spaced dark metallic plates, visible corner bolts and compact feet; attach the source's silver metal inlet/outlet fittings and short U-shaped pipe loops on both sides. The pipe bends and flanges belong to this one exchanger assembly and should end close to the frame. Preserve a frontal three-quarter view and a compact rectangular footprint.
Style/medium: polished realistic industrial concept illustration with reflective brushed-silver pipes, saturated cobalt-blue structural plates, charcoal fin stack, fine bolts and seams, matching the source's crisp metal rendering.
Composition/framing: show the complete single exchanger and its own pipe fittings centered, upright and uncropped on a transparent landscape canvas. Keep the blue exchanger as the dominant focal body; keep attached side loops compact and balanced. Do not add a second machine.
Lighting: neutral overhead highlights on silver steel and subtle cool-blue reflections on the frame. Pipe interiors remain silver; no luminous fluid or colored lighting.
Constraints: outside the single heat exchanger assembly must be genuine transparent RGBA. Include no process route connecting to another unit. Its own short pipe fittings may remain attached and terminate at visible flanges. No floor, ground plane or detached shadow.
Avoid: furnace, production line, exhaust tower, vessel/pump, inter-device pipes or hoses, long orange/teal paths, flow glow, arrows, labels, badges, text, room, paper, grid, horizon, floor, detached shadow, frame, border, watermark, cropped tubing or a flattened front-on redesign.

input_references.role: approved full-slide shape, placement and palette

review: Agent visual review pending final fit; one blue plate exchanger with its attached short silver U-loop fittings, no other equipment, route, text or background.
